programme.sub-title: A Dr. Phil Exclusive: The Boy Under the Stairs
programme.desc: Exclusive interview with Windy Hall, the biological mother whose 5-year-old malnourished son, Jordan Bleimeyer, was locked in a closet by his father and stepmother.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A husband wants his wife to shut down her You Tube channel and focus in their marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother faces tough questions from Dr. Phil as they race to get her two daughters off the streets and into rehab.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A self-proclaimed adult bully is confronted.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Trisha, a mother and wife, who is live streaming her entire life. Trisha claims she’s been bullied and harassed by her online “haters.” But Wendy, one of the women Trisha calls a “hater,” says it’s Trisha who has ruined people’s lives by live streaming their personal information, making negative comments about their appearance, and even claiming they are convicts. Find out what caused Trisha to storm off and collapse on stage. And, why did Dr. Phil almost have to call the paramedics?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Guests claim their pregnancies have lasted well over 9 months– Shayna for one year and Zona for more than three-and-a-half years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Danielle says that her husband of nearly 10 years, John, has been living a secret life -- reaching out to men on Craigslist for sex and looking at child pornography. John insists that the child porn was accidentally downloaded, and while he admits to exchanging emails with men online, he maintains that he never met up with anyone in person. How does he explain his actions? And, what will the results of a polygraph test reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Husband Obsessed: A Wife Accused
programme.desc: The conversation continues as Dr. Phil examines Mike's alleged evidence that his wife cheated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a rare interview, Dina Lohan sets the record straight.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A former FLDS spokesperson, Willie Jessop, comes face to face with critics.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can a man convince his wife to accept a polyfidelic relationship with his mistress?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marcy and Scott say they believe their daughter, Danielle, has Stockholm syndrome from her boyfriend, Justin. They claim Justin is an abusive narcissist who has manipulated their daughter into believing he’s “God’s gift to the world.” Danielle says she loves Justin, and he’s not going anywhere. She says the only reason Justin has ever laid hands on her is to restrain her from her own angry rages, and her parents don’t understand their relationship. Justin says he’s a great guy with an “X factor” and doesn’t understand why Danielle’s parents dislike him. Although he’s currently dealing with a serious legal problem, he says he’s not a criminal, narcissist, or an abuser. And, in a shocking twist, Danielle reveals to Dr.Phil and her parents a secret about her relationship with Justin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do slow drivers make you crazy? Do you start to lose it when cell phone talkers are too loud? People are more on edge than ever, with the slightest thing setting them off.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Bad Boy Blake with Abs of Steel
programme.desc: Blake, 26, abandons his education to smoke pot all day in his mother's rent-free house, where he is verbally abusive and refuses to work.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sixty-two-year-old Bill and his 23-year-old girlfriend, Bri, are one of the couples featured on Lifetime’s television series Marrying Millions. Bill and Bri say not only do they come from two different worlds, but they have a 39-year age gap and are at different stages of their lives – Bri wants a family and children, and Bill has been divorced twice. Bill’s first ex- wife claims Bill has a history of cheating, as she says he cheated on her and has warned Bri it could happen to her. While Bill and Bri have been together for four years, they say they are at a crossroads: what happens when he turns 70 and she is only 31? Also, they say their families don’t see eye-to-eye, which impacts their daily lives. How “healthy” is their relationship? The couple takes Dr. Phil’s “Relationship Health Profile Test” and learns the results. Plus, Dr. Phil speaks with superfans from across the U.S. and has a special announcement for them. One superfan even gets his own “Dr. Phil” tattoo ... live! You won’t want to miss this episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some teachers today are turning schoolboy fantasies into sexual realities with their inappropriate conduct towards underage students. Mary Kay Letourneau, who admitted to authorities that she had sex with a 13-year-old former student; Debra Lafave, accused of having sex with a 14-year-old student, and Pamela Rogers, accused of sending sexually-explicit videos to a 14-year-old boy, are just a few examples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look at a teacher sex scandal that has a school and families divided in a small town in Texas. High school teacher Joelle Ogletree faces accusations of sexual misconduct with some of her male students. Hear both sides of this gripping sex scandal from the accuser and the accused, and judge for yourself if justice has been served.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.desc: Esta historia involucra la noche de graduación, un amor no correspondido en la secundaria, triángulos amorosos y misteriosos asesinatos.

programme.title: Nubes Rojas
programme.desc: Arizona, 1875. Travis Lebeck yace inconsciente en el desierto. Una familia lo rescata y luego él decide continuar su camino.

programme.title: Punto Rojo
programme.desc: Diego, un delincuente y barra brava de "Racing Club", uno de los equipos más grandes de Argentina. programme.desc: Después de que el asesino de su esposa finalmente es sentenciado, un hombre comienza a tener visiones del crimen, revelando una verdad horrible que ha logrado ocultarse a sí mismo.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E38: Cenizas del pasado
programme.desc: Un director ejecutivo despiadado reúne a tres de sus ejecutivos para un juego de póquer muy inusual, cuyas apuestas demuestran ser más de lo que nadie esperaba.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E40: Negacion
programme.desc: Un joven sacerdote desilusionado es enviado a hacerse cargo de una parroquia moribunda, pero descubre que su presencia es resentida por el sacerdote mayor. El joven sacerdote pronto se ve perseguido por el fantasma de una niña que dejó atrás para unirse al clero.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E39: Todo para el ganador
programme.desc: Art Jones, que ha fingido su muerte en una tormenta de nieve en la montaña y mató a su guía de escalada en el proceso, se esconde en una isla tropical humeante, a la espera de un pago de seguro considerable. Después de ocho meses de aislamiento, Art ahora está siendo atormentado por el fantasma del guía de escalada, quien durante una ola de calor abrasador convierte la choza de Art en una congelada jaula de culpa.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E42: Foto de despedida
programme.desc: La experiencia de haber quedado atrapada en un edificio derrumbado ha dejado a Kate Bradshaw claustrofóbica y muda. Mientras un guardia de seguridad descontento la retiene como rehén en un ascensor, Kate se enfrenta a su peor miedo y logra invertir la situación, triunfando sobre su captor y recuperando su voz.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E41: Borrada
programme.desc: Encerrada en un matrimonio rancio con su deslucido esposo, una mujer obsesionada con la juventud comienza a sospechar que él está creando una mujer joven para reemplazarla. Cuando comienza a desaparecer, se entera demasiado tarde de que la mujer es en realidad la versión más joven de sí misma, de la que su esposo se enamoró hace muchos años.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E36: Consumidor
programme.desc: Una vieja viuda demacrada es asesinada por su sobrina engañada y su joven novio, solo para volver a perseguirlos en los espejos.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E37: Solo es una pelicula
programme.desc: Una dueña de tugurios, condenada a arresto domiciliario en su propia propiedad decrépita, es perseguida por los espectros de los inquilinos que sufrieron y murieron en el edificio.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E44: Baja
programme.desc: Habiéndose perdido la foto perfecta de una celebridad a la que ha perseguido durante años, un paparazza busca la toma definitiva: la celebridad ahora muerta que yace en el estado en una funeraria. Pero después de finalmente hacerse una idea, descubre que el fantasma de la celebridad comienza a acosarla sin descanso.

programme.title: Historias De Fantasmas S01E35: La herencia
programme.desc: Una pareja afroamericana está aterrorizada en su nuevo hogar por el fantasma de un hombre racista. Al final, descubrimos el verdadero motivo del fantasma: incapaz de descansar en paz, ha estado buscando el perdón de sus pecados.

programme.desc: Lo más importante en el mercado mundial del arte es si es auténtico o falso. Cuando una falsificación se hace pasar por real, se pueden ganar y perder fortunas. programme.title: El Arte del Robo

programme.title: El Arte del Robo

programme.title: El Arte del Robo

Builders of all levels are in for a great show as Stacey tackles one of a kind steering columns, gas pedals and designing a console that not only fits form, but also function. Gauge techs will keep your instrument panels in line. And a quick tip will keep your wires from fraying and your hoses from splitting. All this and more as Sgt. Rock and Season 10 hit the road full throttle.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: A custom build can lose some power if the theme doesn’t stay consistent. Stacey shows how to do that by taking you through the process of how to make door and kick panels that keep the rugged military WWII bomber vibe flowing throughout the interior of Sgt. Rock. After that, its some tips on how to fit a radiator and that all-important cooling fan in a place where space is limited. Finally, the gas tank and battery placement are critical on a custom vehicle and Stacey goes through the steps in doing that as well. If you’ve always wanted to build a custom vehicle, this episode is sure to get your fabrication gearZ turning.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Two things are certain in life: death and taxes. We all know what to do with taxes, but what happens when a loved one passes and leaves behind an unfinished project vehicle? How do you know what’s sitting in your garage? And how can you find out? Stacey tackles these questions and takes you on a thorough inventory of an almost finished restoration that was left to a widow when her husband suddenly died. A new dash going into your vehicle? A gauge tech should keep you from crossing your wires. And we’ve got tips that should help with battery relocation and lining up your vehicle’s body panels.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Gearz On The Road - Basic Tools
programme.desc: The GearZ crew mount up and head out to visit a young gear-head whose love of wrenching started with 4-wheelers and has grown to include 4-wheel drive pick ups. Young Adam has a few surprises in store as Stacey visits him in his Dad’s garage and discusses tools, storage and tearing apart things to see how they work. Then, it’s back in the shop as Stacey takes on the big question every gear-head has: What OTHER tools should I have in my box? A look beyond the typical wrenches, hammers and clamps will show you what you may need and what you may not, depending on your project.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cheetah Body Work Latches Custom Exhaust
programme.desc: The son of legendary car builder, Bill Thomas, talks shop about wrenching, racing and his father’s Cobra Killer…the Cheetah. Then Stacey heads over to Stainless Works to check out how the Cheetah’s custom side pipes, headers and mufflers came together. A Gauge Tech explains the pros and cons of mechanical vs. electric gauges. After that, a Quick Tip explains the proper way to use some of those mystery tools laying around in your tool box.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Ever wonder why your wife or best buddy won’t step foot in your late model truck? It could be that crusty interior. Tag along as Stacey takes on the sights and smells of an ’83 Chevy in dire need of some attention. From new dash to leather on the bench seat and new carpet in the floor, Stacey shows you what a difference a weekend and some parts from LMC can make. Speaking of trucks, Stacey raises the bar with a bed lifter that will make you the most popular guy in your neighborhood. A new buffer is going to help add some shine to your vehicle and a creeper that’s simply “Magic” is sure to raise an eyebrow or two. Big things are happening in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Through the years, we’ve had some amazing vehicles featured on GearZ—from elite racecars to the insanity of a V-8 barstool. Well, here we go again! Stacey hauls in a Thiokol Imp that needs some…attention. First things first with this crazy snowcatmobile; we’ve got to see if we can make it run. Follow along as Stacey takes you through the ins and outs of getting a neglected vehicle up and running again. For you performance BMW guys, a tuner from Dinan is going add the horses you’ve been looking for. We’ve got sparks flying, fuel splashing and all kinds of garage mayhem this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: In the world of car building there are few things more ominous than missing titles or VIN numbers. But there is one task that stands out, one that brings grown men to tears, one that is usually lurking behind 100 yards of electrical tape…WIRING. Well hold on tight as Stacey dives head first into wiring Sergeant Rock. That’s right; see how painless Stacey can make wiring the big old truck. Follow along as Stacey moves front to back and gets the Rock one step closer to hitting the road!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With summer in full swing, it’s time to cool down that classic truck of yours. That’s right, roll those windows up and feel the cool breeze as Stacey shows just how easy it is to install this complete AC system from LMC Truck. Now that you’re done sweatin’, let’s take a look at headers and intakes and get that motor performing the way it should. And don’t miss out on the ins and outs of turbos and super-chargers…which one fits your needs? All this and plenty of sparks in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew heat things up as they head to the Cornwell forges to watch molten steel be expertly transformed into America’s best ratchet. Get ready to see sparks fly. But the trip doesn’t stop there. Tag along as the crew follows what it takes for a ratchet to end up on a Cornwell truck. Back in the garage, Stacey talks maximizing boost and the role of intercoolers when it comes to super-chargers and turbos. The wheels keep turning and the rubber keeps burning, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Professional wrestler, actor, and former professional football player known for his time in the WWE and WCW as Goldberg returns to the Graveyard! This time, he brings the ghouls two brand new projects - one of which includes installing a brand-new 392 Crate Hemi in his modern Dodge Truck.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Performance with a Touch of Luxury
programme.desc: The Ghouls say goodbye to the 1970 Superbird equipped with a Hellcat Crate Hemi by taking it out for one last drive. Then it’s all hands on deck to get the beautiful second-generation Plymouth GTX in Seafoam Turquoise finished in time for the owner to see it for the first time since his father drove it.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With a Plymouth GTX finished, the ghoulz refocus their efforts on the 1969 Dodge Daytona. With the owner wanting a full restoration, Mark and the Ghouls begin the tedious disassembly. Because of the car’s pristine condition, they take extra effort to document and preserve as much as they can.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The unsung heroes of the body shop begin the restoration on one of the most requested renovations ever: a 1971 Dodge Demon. With several panels needing replacement, Mark and George show the intricate process of grafting an entire front-clip from another vehicle to replace the rusted and damaged original.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s crunch time at Graveyard Carz, Mark and his cousin Dougie fire up the engine for our Turbine Bronze Charger while Dave assembles its firewall in preparation to install the drivetrain.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Look to the West for B5 Blue
programme.desc: Dave is ready to wrap up the 1970 Challenger R/T SE but is waiting for parts. Meanwhile, Mark’s A100 build continues, and after a long and tedious body-work and paint phase, Will is ready to deliver Dave the 1969 B5 Blue Plymouth GTX.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Ghoulz have finished the 1970 Challenger R/T SE. As they take it out for the first test drive in over 15 years, Mark and the team reflect on the trials and challenges throughout the restoration process.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark, Dougie, and Allysa team up to kick things into high-gear around the shop. They begin the restoration of a Challenger T/A, Will paints a 1968 GTX in B7 Blue, Allysa learns how dashes are assembled, and they install the drivetrain for the ultra rare, 1 of 2, 1970 Hemi Convertible Coronet R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark pulls back the curtain on the next four Mopar’s in desperate need of resurrection while also showcasing the fans favorite moments from Seasons 8 and 9.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls are back, and they are ready to get to work! With a call in from the owner of the super rare 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet Hemi Convertible, Mark has to work fast to reach a looming deadline. At the same time, Will primes the body of our 1969 Daytona, bringing it one step closer to being back on the road.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: While Mark is on a road test of the just completed 1968 Charger, its owner surprises the shop by arriving in person! While the owner waits, Will completes the paint on a beautiful 1970 Challenger in B5 blue. Finally, with Mark returned the owner receives his restored Charger and cooks a meal for the Ghouls as thanks!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s time to hit the casino! Mark has been invited to a massive car show at the Little Creek Casino but before he can go there are a few things that need to be finished first. Mark and Doug disassemble the Phoenix ‘Cuda, a car that survived a massive garage fire. At the car show, Allysa and Will interact with fans and find their “pick of the show.”

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark has once again taken Allysa under his wing and is teaching her the finer points of installing a grill and headlights on our 1972 Duster, meanwhile George is in the body shop attaching a tricky quarter panel to a 1969 ‘Cuda which Mark has to check off the list…military style? Finally, the Duster gets it’s drive train and is finally reunited with its engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Who better to explain the history and discuss the changes, year to year, of the Dodge Charger, than the Master of Mopar himself, Mark Worman. In this special episode of Graveyard Carz, Mark will show you unique differences, surprising insights, and cool features on multiple years of the same car: the Dodge Charger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X descubre un viejo experimento militar que involucra un suero de reversión de edad y se sorprende al descubrir que el abuelo de Jesse es uno de los sujetos de prueba.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Al descubrir que su compañera de equipo Lexa es objeto de un experimento encubierto que la está controlando, el equipo de Mutante X busca al médico responsable.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Cuando la vida de Jesse está en juego, Brennan debe conectarse con él y guiarlo a través de recuerdos pasados que han compartido para salvar su vida.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X debe evitar que un científico clone mujeres para usarlas como esclavas en su club de hombres ultra exclusivo.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Las sospechas de Lexa llevan a Mutante X a revelar un campo de exterminio itinerante, que se presenta como un circo para refugiados mutantes y el enemigo de Mutante X dentro del Dominio.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Muchos de los misterios que rodean a Mutante X se revelan cuando Lexa y Jesse son capturados por el Dominio, y el equipo, junto con Adam, entra a rescatarlos.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un empático mutante que huye de unos misteriosos agentes del gobierno es rescatado por un equipo de compañeros "Nuevos Mutantes", el grupo conocido como Mutante X.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Brennan es capturado y cae bajo el control de Eckhart, quien se ve obligado a trabajar contra los Nuevos Mutantes.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Shalimar se vuelve más cercana a otro salvaje cuando es "lujuria a primera vista", pero las cosas se complican cuando su nuevo novio intenta encontrar una cura para su condición.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante es secuestrado de su familia, y Mutante X se propone recuperarlo y averiguar cuál es el interés de Eckhart con él.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Cuando una plaga que solo afecta a los mutantes se desata, Adam y Eckhart aceptan trabajar juntos para encontrar una cura.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Eckhart busca un mutante que pueda absorber energía, uno con el que Brennan se involucre románticamente.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un niño que está desarrollando nuevas habilidades mutantes ha sido secuestrado y el equipo accede a buscarlo para su madre. Más tarde se enteran de que fue ella quien secuestró a su hijo.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.sub-title: El Ascenso de la Estrella Oscura
programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con algunas personas que intentan ingresar a un laboratorio de Genomex y descubren que son salvajes.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.sub-title: Un Tono mas Blanco de Palidez
programme.desc: Un nuevo mutante con el poder de la invisibilidad está trabajando contra Eckhart y Adam, a pesar de que estuvo involucrada con Adam en el pasado.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un viejo amigo de Brennan los atrae a él y a Emma a una trampa. Emma termina dividida en dos entidades separadas, una buena y otra mala.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Jesse es acorralado en una misión secreta mortal por su padre separado, que está trabajando contra Eckhart.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con un mutante que mata a otros mutantes al drenar su energía y también puede volver a la vida después de ser asesinado.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Emma se reúne con un viejo amigo que posee poderes de telecyber. Sin embargo, la reunión se vuelve peligrosa cuando Michelle intenta entregar a Emma a la GSA.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Adam es acusado de asesinato por un nuevo mutante con la capacidad de robar los recuerdos de las personas.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Un mutante con habilidades telepáticas que puede hacer que la gente experimente, mentalmente, cualquier cosa que quiera, logra meterse en la mente de Mutante X. Ahora los está haciendo experimentar sus peores miedos.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El ex novio de Shalimar aparece y está tratando de recuperar un huevo de Fabergé que contiene un microchip de extraordinario poder.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El equipo intenta evitar que Eckhart adquiera un elemento raro, pero un ladrón lo consigue. La mujer que tiene la capacidad de hacer que los hombres se enamoren de ella pone su mirada en Brennan.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Mutante X se encuentra con una nueva facción de Nuevos Mutantes llamada Strand, liderada por el poderoso primer mutante Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: En un intento desesperado por salvar su propia vida, Ashlocke revive a un antiguo alquimista egipcio que representa una amenaza letal para el equipo Mutante X.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: Ashlocke retrocede en el tiempo para intentar hacerse invencible dándole algo a su yo más joven, lo que llevó a Brennan y Shalimar a seguirlo.

programme.title: Mutant X
programme.desc: El equipo se adentra en el desierto para localizar a una bestia asesina que tiene como objetivo a los excursionistas.

programme.title: USA Through the Great Outdoors
programme.desc: Place is inextricably linked to who we are as human beings. See the American Great Outdoors in its purest and most authentic light – through the eyes of locals.

programme.title: Amplify
programme.desc: Singer/songwriter Summer Dean visits her college stomping grounds and discovers it offers more music history than Buddy Holly. Punk rock drummer Phanie Diaz checks out local art in San Antonio and rapper Lou Charles.

programme.title: Amplify
programme.desc: Lou hooks up with keyboardist Patric Johnston while Summer records an original song at a legendary recording studio. Phanie learns about the multicultural history of the accordion aka Texas squeezebox.

programme.title: Amplify
programme.desc: Phanie gets a lesson in the bajo sexto, a 12-stringed guitar, while Lou meets the owner of Houston’s independent record shop Vinal Edge. Summer tries her hand at graffiti art.

programme.title: Amplify
programme.desc: Summer jams with Nathen Rogers and his band, La Croix Boix. Lou gets a tour of Sugarhill Recording Studio and Phanie’s punk band plays alongside the accordion-powered Tex Mex band Piñata Protest.

programme.title: Paul & Nick's Big American Food Trip
programme.desc: In the middle of rural Maine, Paul and Nick create an outside barbeque for the family of John Mann, an eighth generation Ulster-Scot immigrant. The Manns are true frontier-people, and completely self sufficient from their land.

programme.title: Paul & Nick's Big American Food Trip
programme.desc: Chefs Paul Rankin and Nick Nairn are in Lexington, Virginia to cook for descendants of the Ulster-Scots Lewis family who settled in the area in the 18th century. Along the way they visit a heritage pig farmer, taste some sparkling cider and they discover some delicious goat’s cheese in the heart of Virginia’s Piedmont region where Paul has a close encounter with a friendly goat…

programme.title: Playgrounds
programme.desc: See some of the best playgrounds in the USA through the lens of athletes.

programme.title: USA Through Film 2
programme.desc: Actor and director Jordan Spiro (Ozark, Night Comes On) spent childhood vacations with her family in New Orleans. For Spiro, the city’s heritage as the birthplace of jazz is reflected in its mélange of arts and food culture that always feels fresh, inviting, and joyous, even after a lifetime of visits. “There’s this ‘all senses on overload’ side to New Orleans that takes my breath away every time.”

programme.title: Ask a Local
programme.desc: From beaches to bike trails to breweries, the United States has something for everyone to explore. Hear from the locals themselves and discover the best places to eat, shop, play, and more.

programme.title: Roadfood Adventures USA
programme.desc: Travel along the West to some of the most colorful roads, delicious food, magnificent scenery, magic moments, and fascinating people all along the way.

programme.title: Lucky in Love Ep 1
programme.desc: Canadians Sophie and Anna go on a journey of discovery, luck and love in the Cradle of Liberty, Boston, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Lucky in Love Ep 2
programme.desc: Gabby and Jono try their luck in panoramic Salt Lake City, Utah.

programme.title: Lucky in Love Ep 3

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: NEW 11/7 - Jimmy Traina Mailbag: YouTubeTV vs. ESPN; Drew Brees and More!
programme.desc: Episode 580 of "SI Media With Jimmy Traina" is an all-Mailbag episode. The show starts off with Jimmy explaining why the podcast was delayed this week and why there isn't a main guest. The "Traina Thoughts" segment featuring Sal Licata from WFAN and SNY follows the intro. Topics covered include the YouTubeTV-ESPN carriage dispute, the passing of NFL broadcaster Bob Trumpy, the Dodgers beating the Blue Jays in Game 7 of the World Series, Sal's interview with actress Sydney Sweeney and more. Following "Traina Thoughts," Jimmy opens up the mailbag. This week, listeners had questions about Fox hiring Drew Brees to essentially replace Mark Sanchez on its No. 3 NFL crew, the performances of Joe Davis and John Smoltz throughout the Major League Baseball postseason, in-game manager interviews, Jimmy's process for writing his daily "Traina Thoughts" column, whether Jimmy hates a couple of New York sports media people, ranking the "Seinfeld" seasons and slicing a bagel.

Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E2

Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E3

In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E4

As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E5

Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E6

After the shock wore off, Lisa went into full action ahead as her will to live proved stronger than her devastating cancer.

programme.title: Roaring To Victory - Jaguar
programme.desc: After an absence of almost three decades, Jaguar returned to top flight sportscar racing in 1985. This is the action-packed story of how the legendary British marque roared back to victory. Archive race footage traces the full story of how Tom Walkinshaw Racing took Jaguar to the top, claiming World Championship success and securing Jaguar's first victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours for 31 years. This film features highlights from the road to victory, from the debut of the XJR-6 at Canada's Mosport in August 1985 through to the 1988 Le Mans triumph of the XJR-9LM. You'll see the Tony Southgate-designed Jaguars in action at iconic circuits like Spa, Silverstone, Monza, Fuji and, of course, the Circuit de la Sarthe, from 1985, '86, '87 and '88. There's fabulous race highlights, including in-car footage, featuring Jaguar racing greats including Derek Warwick, Eddie Cheever, Martin Brundle, Jan Lammers, Raul Boesel, John Watson, Johnny Dumfries, Andy Wallace, Jean-Louis Schlesser and more. There's interviews with many of these stars, plus contributions from Tom Walkinshaw and Jaguar chairman Sir John Egan. Roaring to Victory is the comprehensive story of three incredible years.

programme.title: Gearing Up 2025 - Episode 9: Monster Jam & the TransAnatolia
programme.desc: Welcome to the ninth episode of Gearing Up for 2025! It’s the TV series that takes you around the globe, following the hottest action from some of the world’s most unique competitions. High skills, passion for technology, impatience for innovation, and pure love for adrenaline, are combined at their best. So, start your engines, tighten your seat belts, and get ready to feel the G-force with some serious action! From the raw horsepower and roaring crowds of Monster Jam, we dive into the endurance and grit of the TransAnatolia 2025, one of the most demanding cross-country rallies on the planet. The journey continues to Arendal, showcasing the Nordic spirit of motorsport where precision meets power. To cap it off, viewers get an exclusive first look at the upcoming Hellas Rally Raid 24h, promising relentless action across the Greek terrain. Each segment highlights the extremes of man, machine, and nature colliding in pursuit of speed and glory. And that’s a wrap on the ninth episode of Gearing Up 2025!

programme.desc: Bells Beach on Victoria's South Coast is the longest-running surfing competition and will host the 62st edition this year. Bells is Australian surfing heritage. With the hope of scoring long-period, groomed walls, the surfers will need to display the perfect combination of power, precision, and timing. The biggest surfing legends have had the honor of winning and ringing ‘The Bell' and 2025 will see a hungry new generation vying for the opportunity to cement their names in one of surfing's most prestigious events.

programme.desc: After heading inland for a whirlwind adventure in the Sahara Desert, the crew says farewell to Lucy as she heads home to Australia. Back in Algiers, Sam, Erwan, and Dihya visit one of the country's leading digital agencies to discuss their journey and go for one last surf in some perfect longboard waves. Before leaving the country, Sam and Erwan talk with local surfers Dihya and Walid about the future of surfing in Algeria and how the emergence of the sport could impact the people there.

As the third stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, this event is crucial for competitors looking to build momentum in their World Title campaigns.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Western Australia Margaret River Pro 2025
programme.desc: The Western Australia Margaret River Pro is the 7th stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, running from May 17 to May 27. This crucial event marks the mid-season decider, where the world's best surfers put it all on the line to advance through the next section of the tour. It is also the third and final stop of the GWM Aussie Treble. Margaret River will bring the action with pumping waves and strong competition.

programme.title: URI - The Surgical Strike

programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.
